free_tier_limits.correction: Self-hosted Traccar is free and open source without software-use limits. Official hosted services are paid, starting at $9.95/month; their product pages describe a one-time 7-day trial rather than an ongoing hosted free tier. Public demo servers are intended for testing.

description.correction: Traccar exposes REST endpoints for devices, positions, geofences, users, groups, and reports, plus a WebSocket endpoint for live updates. It supports direct HTTP Basic authentication, Bearer account tokens, and session cookies. A password-based session is created by POSTing form-encoded email and password to /api/session, not by a Basic Auth login to that endpoint.

notes: Checked current official API documentation (version 6.14.5), authentication guidance, configuration reference, and pricing pages. No official REST request-rate policy was located. CORS is deployment-configurable through web.origin, but the current demo server's effective policy could not be established.
